brief:
Israeli occupation authorities announced plans to allocate approximately 180 dunams of land in Qalandia, north of occupied Jerusalem, for a project titled "agricultural product processing," Shehab Wire reported. The move has sparked Palestinian concerns about expanding settlement activities and strengthening Israeli control over Palestinian territory.

The planned facility is part of broader efforts that Palestinians say aim to isolate Jerusalem from its surrounding areas, according to the report. Settlements and related infrastructure projects have long been central to Israeli policy in the occupied West Bank.

title: Israel plans agricultural facility on 180 dunams in Qalandia north of Jerusalem
